info.title: MokiBox API
info.description: Backend video-sharing MVP with local Marketplace v1, served by api-gateway. All endpoints below are proxied by Nginx (port 80/443) under /api/. Responses use the shared envelope: {"data": <resource>} for single resources, {"data": [...], "pagination": {"next_cursor": ...|null}} for lists, and {"error": {"code", "message", "details?"}} for errors. Errors collapse unauthorized reads to 404 (anti-enumeration); see shared/errors.go for the stable code list.

servers.description: API root. Behind the Nginx edge (default in production); paths below are absolute (they start with /api/).

get.summary: Public liveness probe — always 200 while the gateway process is alive.
Serve the raw OpenAPI 3.0 document (this file).
Minimal Swagger UI page (loaded from CDN) rendering the spec at /api/docs/swagger.json. Also served as /api/docs/ (trailing-slash alias).

post.summary: Actions V2 webhook from Zitadel (user.deactivated, user.removed). Signature-verified; no JWT.
post.description: Verified via the ZITADEL-Signature header: HMAC-SHA256 over `<unix-seconds>.<raw_body>` — the signature input is the Unix timestamp in decimal + "." + the exact raw request body (zitadel-go actions.computeSignature: mac.Write(fmt.Sprintf("%d", t.Unix())); mac.Write([]byte(".")); mac.Write(payload)), keyed with the HMAC signing key. Header format `t=<unix-seconds>,v1=<hex>` (dual-header fallback), 300s timestamp tolerance. Rate limited: 0.5/s (30/min), burst 30, per client IP. Any other event_type -> 400 WEBHOOK_EVENT_UNSUPPORTED. Successful 200 responses contain {"status":"processed"} inside the shared envelope's data field — there is NO `event` field on the 200 body.

requestBody.description: Actions V2 event payload (case-sensitive field names).

200.description: ACK: {"data":{"status":"processed"}}. Also 200 when the affected user has no local row yet (nothing to do; Zitadel stops retrying).

400.description: Bad payload shape or unsupported event_type (WEBHOOK_EVENT_UNSUPPORTED).

401.description: 401 WEBHOOK_INVALID_SIGNATURE — signature missing, mismatched, or stale.

get.summary: Get the authenticated user's profile.

put.summary: Partially update the authenticated user's profile (display_name, bio, avatar_url, is_private).
put.description: All fields optional; omitted fields are left unchanged (COALESCE semantics). Passing back one of the user's own presigned R2 avatar URLs keeps the avatar — otherwise use avatar upload-intent/confirm. Rejected for other users' URLs.

delete.summary: Delete the authenticated user's account (self-service tombstone; 204 on success).
delete.description: Soft delete: users row tombstoned (is_active=false, deleted_at set, username rewritten to deleted_<id>), counter corrections applied, videos/likes/comments/follows/notifications deleted, R2 objects scheduled for cleanup via the cleanup:objects queue task.

get.summary: Get the public profile of a user plus follow-graph stats.
get.description: Inactive or missing users return 404 (anti-enumeration). Private accounts: only the owner or followers see the full profile; others get 404.

get.summary: List videos owned by a user (cursor paginated).
get.description: Owner sees all statuses except DELETED; non-owners see READY videos only (private accounts: followers only, otherwise 404).

200.description: Page envelope: data = [UserVideoItem], pagination.next_cursor null on last page

post.summary: Start an avatar upload: returns a presigned PUT URL for the raw file (JPEG/PNG/WebP, ≤5 MiB).
post.description: The file is uploaded directly to Cloudflare R2 — NOT through this gateway (no body limit here). Existing intent for this user is replaced; previous key scheduled for cleanup. upload_url expires after the presign TTL (default 15 min). Rejects anything that is not a real JPEG/PNG/WebP image at confirm time.

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR (invalid JSON / body shape) or 400 for unsupported content_type (must be image/jpeg, image/png, or image/webp)

post.summary: Confirm the avatar upload: validates the object (present, ≤5 MiB, real JPEG/PNG/WebP bytes) and activates avatar_key.

200.description: Avatar confirmed; avatar_url is now active

409.description: AVATAR_UPLOAD_CONFLICT (intent expired/replaced), UPLOAD_MISSING (object not in R2), or UPLOAD_SIZE_INVALID.

post.summary: Follow a user (idempotent — ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; existing row untouched).
post.description: Self-follow -> 400 SELF_FOLLOW_NOT_ALLOWED (explicit denial, not anti-enumeration). Inactive target -> 404. A best-effort `follow` notification is inserted for the target (failure does not undo the follow).

delete.summary: Unfollow a user (idempotent — silently no-ops on missing rows).
delete.description: Wire response always reports is_following=false, created_at="" (no row to timestamp).

get.summary: List followers of a user (cursor paginated).
get.description: Private accounts: visible to followers only; everyone else gets 404 (anti-enumeration). Owner always sees the own list.

get.summary: List users followed by a user (cursor paginated).
get.description: Same visibility rule as followers (private accounts: followers only, otherwise 404).

post.summary: Start a video upload: returns a presigned PUT URL for the raw file (uploaded directly to R2).
post.description: Title required (1–200 visible chars after trim; whitespace-only rejected). Description optional (max 5000 chars). Reuses the user's PENDING_UPLOAD row when one exists (r2_key rotated, previous key scheduled for cleanup). 201 on create, 200 on reuse. Client must PUT with Content-Type: application/octet-stream. Size 1 KiB–200 MiB (validated at confirm).

post.summary: Confirm the uploaded video: flips PENDING_UPLOAD → PROCESSING and enqueues the transcode job.
post.description: video_id and r2_key must both match the row. R2 object checked at confirm (HeadObject + size 1 KiB–200 MiB + owner match): missing -> 409 UPLOAD_MISSING (row stays PENDING_UPLOAD); out-of-range -> 400 UPLOAD_SIZE_INVALID (invalid object scheduled for cleanup, row stays PENDING_UPLOAD); concurrent mutation -> 409 VIDEO_STATUS_CONFLICT. Asynq retries: 1 queue-level retry (MaxRetry(1)); worker re-enqueues up to 3 application-level retries with ProcessIn(30s * retry_count).

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR (malformed body / bad video_id) or UPLOAD_SIZE_INVALID

get.summary: Home feed: READY videos from active owners — public accounts plus accounts the viewer follows. The viewer's own videos are excluded.
get.description: Pagination over (created_at DESC, id DESC); cursor is base64url of `<RFC3339Nano>|<uuid>`; a next_cursor is emitted only on full pages.

get.summary: Search users and/or videos (case-insensitive ILIKE on username/title/description; underscore/wildcard chars escaped).

200.description: Search response (custom envelope; data.users and data.videos are independently cursored)

get.summary: Full VideoObject for a video.
get.description: Owner: any status. Non-owner: status must be READY, owner active, and — when the owner is private — the viewer must follow them. All failures collapse to 404 (anti-enumeration).

delete.summary: Owner-only delete: tombstone (status=DELETED + deleted_at) and enqueue cleanup:video after 24h; 204 on success.
delete.description: Idempotent: already-deleted videos return 204; a non-owner or missing video returns 404 (anti-enumeration).

204.description: Video tombstoned; cleanup:video enqueued for after the 24h grace.

get.summary: Processing status of a video — OWNER ONLY.
get.description: duration_seconds is null until the transcode completes. Non-owner or missing -> 404.

get.summary: Signed HLS playlist for a READY video (raw application/vnd.apple.mpegurl, not the JSON envelope).
get.description: Master playlist by default; pass ?variant=480p or ?variant=720p for the variant playlist whose .ts segment URLs are presigned R2 GETs. Auth: Bearer JWT OR anonymous ?token=<media token> (same handler verifies either; token path skips visibility checks). 404 if status != READY (anti-enumeration; playlist mode has no owner bypass — private owners use the ?token= path).

401.description: 401 — missing/invalid Bearer token AND no valid ?token= media token

post.summary: Like a video (idempotent — re-like is a no-op returning current counter).

delete.summary: Unlike a video (idempotent — no notification on unlike).

post.summary: Track one view (no per-user dedup — every POST counts).
Create a top-level comment (max 1000 visible chars). 201 Created; video comments_count incremented in the same tx; notification to the owner (skipped on self-comment).

get.summary: List comments of a video (created_at DESC, id DESC; cursor paginated).
get.description: Same visibility rule as /api/videos/{id} — a private video's comments never leak; non-READY videos return 404 for non-owners.

delete.summary: Delete a comment and its whole reply subtree (owner only; 204 on success).
delete.description: Deletion is atomic: subtree size counted first, rows deleted, video comments_count decremented by the subtree size — all in one tx. Non-owner or missing -> 404 (anti-enumeration).

post.summary: Reply to a comment — the new CommentObject carries parent_id set.
post.description: Notification fan-out (deduped): video owner + parent comment author each get a type=comment notification, skipping the actor and any recipient already notified.

get.summary: List notifications of the authenticated user (newest first; cursor paginated).
get.description: payload is opaque producer-defined JSON, forwarded verbatim (follow: {username}; like: {username, video_id}; comment: {username, video_id, comment_id}).

put.summary: Mark every unread notification as read.
put.description: Idempotent; updated_count is 0 when the inbox was already fully read.

get.summary: List the fixed Marketplace categories.

200.description: Category list in the standard data envelope.

get.summary: Browse active listings with filters and keyset pagination.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Required together with longitude and radius_km.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Required together with latitude and radius_km.

parameters.name: radius_km
parameters.description: Location radius in km; required together with latitude and longitude.

200.description: Active listing page with presigned image URLs.

post.summary: Create an active listing.

201.description: Created listing in the standard data envelope.

post.summary: Register or rotate the caller's E2EE DM device.
post.description: Requires DM_E2EE_ENABLED=true. device_id and identity keys are public key material; private keys are never sent. Re-registering with a new device_id replaces the old device and invalidates its one-time keys.

get.summary: Read an active or sold listing; archived listings are seller-only.

200.description: Listing detail and active photo URLs.

put.summary: Replace editable fields on the seller's listing.

post.summary: Upload one-time keys (and optional fallback key) for the registered device.
post.description: Requires DM_E2EE_ENABLED=true. Keys are stored as public material only and consumed one at a time when another user fetches a key bundle.

409.description: Stale device or duplicate key id (DM_DEVICE_STALE / DM_KEY_UNAVAILABLE).

get.summary: Fetch a recipient's public key bundle.
get.description: Requires DM_E2EE_ENABLED=true. Mutual followers may fetch the bundle unless either user blocked the other. A one-time key is only consumed when include_one_time_key=true.

parameters.name: include_one_time_key
parameters.description: Consume and return one one-time key. Default false.

403.description: Caller is not a mutual follower, or either user blocked the other.

patch.summary: Set a seller-owned listing to active, sold, or archived.

get.summary: List the authenticated seller's listings.
List another seller's active, unexpired listings.
get.description: Listings expire 30 days after creation and are removed from browse, favorites, seller pages, reports, and contact grants.

post.summary: Create a seller-scoped presigned R2 image upload intent.

201.description: Upload URL, required headers, image_id, 10 MiB size cap, and expiry.

post.summary: Validate image size and bytes before publishing the photo.

200.description: Published photo with a short-lived presigned GET URL.

409.description: Upload intent expired or object is missing/invalid.

delete.summary: Remove a seller-owned photo and enqueue its R2 object for cleanup.

post.summary: Set a published photo as the listing cover.
post.description: Only the seller may set the cover. Replacing the cover clears the previous flag in the same transaction; each listing has at most one cover.

post.summary: Save an active listing; idempotent.

get.summary: List active listings saved by the authenticated user.

post.summary: Submit one manual-moderation report per user and listing.
Create, reuse, or renew a buyer/seller DM permission for an active listing.
post.description: The grant permits both users to use existing E2EE DM endpoints without mutual follows while it is active. It expires after 30 days and can be revoked by either party; contacting again renews an expired, non-revoked grant. It does not create plaintext messages.

200.description: listing_id, seller_user_id, and whether the grant was created or renewed.

delete.summary: Revoke an active contact grant and purge queued ciphertext if no other grant or mutual-follow still permits the pair.
delete.description: Buyers omit buyer_id; sellers must send buyer_id because revoking without it would affect every buyer on the listing.

parameters.name: buyer_id
parameters.description: Target buyer UUID; required when the seller revokes.

200.description: listing_id and whether the grant was revoked.

403.description: Caller is not a participant of the targeted contact grant.

get.summary: List manual-moderation reports (moderator allowlist only).
get.description: Requires the caller's UUID in MARKETPLACE_MODERATOR_USER_IDS. Filters: open, dismissed, resolved.

200.description: Report page with reviewer audit metadata.

403.description: Caller is not a Marketplace moderator (FORBIDDEN).

post.summary: Dismiss or resolve an open report (moderator allowlist only).

403.description: Caller is not a Marketplace moderator (FORBIDDEN).

post.summary: Send an opaque ciphertext message to another device.
post.description: Requires DM_E2EE_ENABLED=true. Only olm protocol version 1 is accepted. The relay stores ciphertext only and expires messages after DM_INBOX_TTL (168h).

200.description: Idempotent replay of an existing client_message_id

403.description: Recipient is not authorized for this caller (not a mutual follower, or either user blocked the other).

409.description: Stale device or idempotency conflict (DM_DEVICE_STALE / DM_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT).

get.summary: Poll pending ciphertext messages for the registered device.
get.description: Requires DM_E2EE_ENABLED=true. Returned messages are not marked delivered; call POST /api/dm/inbox/{message_id}/ack after the client has stored them.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Exclusive sequence cursor (non-negative integer); use 0 for the first poll and next_after for subsequent polls.

post.summary: Acknowledge a delivered ciphertext message.
post.description: Requires DM_E2EE_ENABLED=true. Idempotent: repeated acks return 204. The device must match the message recipient device.

post.summary: Block another user from DMs.
post.description: Requires DM_E2EE_ENABLED=true. The block is symmetric: neither user can fetch a key bundle or send messages to the other. Existing ciphertext and idempotency state for the pair is purged. Blocking does not unfollow either user.

delete.description: Requires DM_E2EE_ENABLED=true. Only the caller's own block is removed; mutual follow still governs whether DMs are allowed afterwards.

bearerAuth.description: Zitadel access token, verified by api-gateway/middleware.Authenticate (OIDC discovery + JWKS against ZITADEL_ISSUER_URL, audience ZITADEL_API_CLIENT_ID). The gateway resolves the local user row by id. Global security alternative for all non-public endpoints.

zitadelOAuth.description: Login interaktif lewat tombol Authorize: Zitadel OIDC Authorization Code + PKCE (tanpa client secret).

UserId.name: id
UserId.description: Target user UUID (uuid.Parse on the server).

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous response's pagination.next_cursor (base64url of `<RFC3339Nano>|<uuid>`). Empty = first page.

SearchQ.name: q
SearchQ.description: Search text; trimmed; 1–100 visible characters (UTF-8 rune count); '%', '_' and '\' are escaped for ILIKE. Underscore matches literal '_' exactly.

SearchType.name: type
SearchType.description: Which resource types to search. Default 'all'.

SearchCursor.name: cursor
SearchCursor.description: Offset cursor: base64url of `offset:<n>` (n is a non-negative integer ≤ 100000). Absent/empty = offset 0.

Variant.name: variant
Variant.description: Variant playlist requested from the master playlist. Omit for the master. Note: strings are compared with < on the response side; the allow-list is {"480p", "720p"}.

MediaToken.name: token
MediaToken.description: Media token minted by the API (shared.NewMediaToken over video_id). Required for anonymous access — without an Authorization header the endpoint returns 401. Valid for the configured MediaTokenTTL.

ZitadelSignature.name: ZITADEL-Signature
ZitadelSignature.description: Actions V2 signature header: format `t=<unix-seconds>,v1=<hex-hmac>` over the raw request body (HMAC-SHA256 with the ZITADEL_TARGET_SIGNING_KEY). Also accepts dual-header form.

HealthStatus.description: GET /healthz response (handlers.HealthHandler). Trivial by design — Docker healthcheck is the liveness authority.

DocsSwaggerSpec.description: The raw OpenAPI 3.0.3 document served by GET /api/docs/swagger.json (this file, embedded via go:embed).

ErrorResponse.description: The error envelope produced by shared.RespondError — the canonical {"error":{...}} shape used by every endpoint.

code.description: Machine-readable code from shared/errors.go, e.g. VALIDATION_ERROR, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, NOT_FOUND, VIDEO_STATUS_CONFLICT, AVATAR_UPLOAD_CONFLICT, VIDEO_NOT_READY, UPLOAD_MISSING, UPLOAD_SIZE_INVALID, SELF_FOLLOW_NOT_ALLOWED, WEBHOOK_INVALID_SIGNATURE, WEBHOOK_EVENT_UNSUPPORTED, INTERNAL_ERROR, RATE_LIMITED.

UserProfile.description: User profile — shared by GET/PUT /api/users/me and GET /api/users/{id} (userProfileResponse). avatar_url is a short-lived presigned R2 GET when the user has an R2-hosted avatar; null otherwise.

UserProfileWithStats.description: UserProfile + follow-graph stats, returned by GET /api/users/{id}.

UserSummary.description: Narrow user reference embedded in VideoObject, CommentObject, follow lists, and search results. Deliberately excludes bio / is_active / created_at.

VideoObject.description: One video entry on feed / detail / search results (handlers/video_object.go). thumbnail_url is a presigned R2 GET (MediaTokenTTL window); hls_playlist_url points at the playlist endpoint with an embedded media token.

UserVideoItem.description: Subset of VideoObject returned by GET /api/users/{id}/videos (userVideoItem). LikedByMe and ThumbnailURL/HLSPlaylistURL are always null today — like state and presigning are not wired on this endpoint.

CommentObject.description: One comment (top-level or reply) on a video. parent_id is null for top-level comments.

LikeObject.description: Response of the like / unlike endpoints (handlers/social.go).

FollowObject.description: Response of the follow / unfollow endpoints.

created_at.description: ISO-8601; empty string on unfollow (no row to timestamp).

payload.description: Opaque producer-defined JSON (string→string maps today: {username, video_id, comment_id}).

UploadIntentRequest.description: Body of POST /api/videos/upload-intent. Title is required (1–200 visible chars after trim; whitespace-only rejected). Description is optional (max 5000 chars).

UploadIntentResponse.description: Response of POST /api/videos/upload-intent (handlers/video.go uploadIntentResponse). Client PUTs the raw video to upload_url with Content-Type: application/octet-stream. upload_url expires after the presign TTL (default 15 min). Size 1 KiB–200 MiB (validated at confirm).

upload_headers.description: Headers the client must send on the presigned PUT (e.g. Content-Type: application/octet-stream).

ConfirmRequest.description: Body of POST /api/videos/confirm. video_id + r2_key must match the row.

retry_count.description: Always 0 on success (the confirm query resets it).

UpdateMeRequest.description: Body of PUT /api/users/me. Omitted/null fields are left unchanged.

avatar_url.description: Behaviour (per UpdateMe in handlers/user.go): if the value is the user's own presigned R2 avatar URL — https://<r2-host>/<bucket>/avatars/<userID>/<uuid>.<ext> with X-Amz-* query params (isPresignedAvatarURLForUser) — the request is IGNORED (field left unchanged). Any other non-null value is stored as the legacy avatar_url field and the user's previous R2 avatar key is scheduled for cleanup. Omitted/null: no change. New avatars should go through the avatar upload-intent/confirm flow.

content_type.description: Avatar format. Actual bytes are decoded and format-checked at confirm (dimensions not currently bounded).

avatar_key.description: Key of the form avatars/<userID>/<uuid>.<ext> — pass to /api/users/me/avatar/confirm.

max_size_bytes.description: 5 MiB hard limit, validated at confirm.

CommentRequestBody.description: Body of POST /api/videos/{id}/comments and POST /api/comments/{id}/reply. Content is trimmed and must be 1–1000 non-whitespace characters.

SearchResponse.description: Response of GET /api/search — NOTE: uses a custom envelope (searchEnvelope), not the standard shared envelope.

pagination.description: users_next_cursor / videos_next_cursor are omitted when that result set is exhausted.

WebhookPayload.description: Actions V2 event payload (handlers/webhook.go zitadelActionV2Event). Field names are case-sensitive: aggregateID, event_type, etc.

aggregateID.description: For user.* events: the affected user (Zitadel subject).

sequence.description: Actions V2 sequence number (json.Number on the wire).

userID.description: The triggering actor id; fallback when aggregateID is absent.

event_payload.description: Present but currently unused by the handler.

WebhookAck.description: Webhook success ACK — verified against handlers/webhook.go: 200 body is exactly {"data":{"status":"processed"}}; there is no `event` field on the 200 response; 200 also when the target has no local row (nothing to do; Zitadel stops retrying).

PageEnvelope.description: shared.RespondList wire shape: {"data": [...], "pagination": {"next_cursor": "<opaque>"|null}}. next_cursor is null on the last page. Items are the endpoint's resource objects (see each path for the item schema).

DMRegisterDeviceRequest.description: POST /api/dm/device body. Only public key material is sent; private keys stay on the client.

replaced_device.description: True when a previous device was replaced by this registration.

DMOneTimeKey.description: Base64url public one-time key material with its Ed25519 signature.

DMKeyBundle.description: Recipient's public key bundle. one_time_key is consumed when present; fallback_key is only present when the recipient uploaded one.

DMSendRequest.description: POST /api/dm/messages body. ciphertext is opaque to the server; only olm protocol version 1 is accepted.

ciphertext.description: Base64url opaque ciphertext; never decrypted by the relay.

NotFound.description: 404 — resource missing, or not visible to the caller (anti-enumeration; NOT_FOUND).

RateLimited.description: 429 — per-user daily quota or per-IP write limiter exceeded (RATE_LIMITED).
